question: Deploy rtvi-cv-3d on the sample dataset.
ground_truth: The agent uses the vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d skill to bring up the MV3DT stack on the bundled warehouse-4cams-20mx20m-synthetic dataset with MODE=mv3dt and BP_PROFILE=bp_wh_kafka. After deploy, the core containers (vss-rtvi-cv-mv3dt, vss-rtvi-cv-bev-fusion, mosquitto, and kafka or redis) are running and BEV Fusion reports healthy.
expected_behavior: Loads the vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d skill rather than the vss-deploy-profile warehouse reference.
Surfaces the profile-size choice (extended vs minimal) instead of silently picking minimal.
Sets MODE=mv3dt and BP_PROFILE to bp_wh_kafka or bp_wh_redis; does not fabricate unsupported values or use bp_wh_auto_calib.
Leaves the core MV3DT containers running, with vss-rtvi-cv-bev-fusion healthy via its compose health check.
Does not print plaintext API tokens in the response.

question: Verify the deployment is healthy and data is flowing.
ground_truth: The agent confirms the stack is actually processing streams, not just that containers are up: perception reports the expected active-source count, BEV Fusion is healthy, and the mdx-raw and mdx-bev broker offsets are increasing.
expected_behavior: Checks BEV Fusion health via docker inspect of the compose health status, not via docker exec test -f /tmp/fusion_ready.
Reads broker offsets with kafka-get-offsets (or redis-cli XLEN when STREAM_TYPE=redis), not the removed GetOffsetShell tool.
Confirms mdx-raw and mdx-bev offsets are growing before reporting success.
Surfaces the VST video wall URL and explains overlays render only under the extended profile.
Does not print plaintext API tokens in the response.

question: Tear down the MV3DT deployment.
ground_truth: The agent tears the MV3DT stack down so no MV3DT containers remain running and the MV3DT named volumes are removed, while preserving the .env file and NGC credentials.
expected_behavior: Runs docker compose down against the warehouse-operations compose file.
Leaves no MV3DT containers running afterwards.
Removes the MV3DT named volumes.
Preserves the .env file and ~/.ngc/config credentials.
Does not print plaintext API tokens in the response.

question: Run RTVI-CV-3D / MV3DT on my own 4-camera warehouse videos.
ground_truth: The agent routes to the videos flow: it checks whether calibration is present for the dataset and, when missing, chains into vss-generate-video-calibration to produce it before deploying the MV3DT stack.
expected_behavior: Loads the vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d skill and identifies the videos data source.
Checks for calibration on disk and chains to vss-generate-video-calibration when it is missing.
Lands the calibration output at the expected MV3DT mount path before deploying.
Proceeds to deploy MV3DT only after calibration is in place.
Does not print plaintext API tokens in the response.
